steps.title: Vault scopes
steps.note: Vault routes accept Clerk sessions or scoped enterprise tokens. vault:read grants GET access, vault:write grants mutation, and * grants everything. CredentialContext.allows_request maps HTTP methods and paths to these scopes.

steps.title: Sealing credentials
steps.note: The plaintext oauth_value is sealed with token_crypto::seal before it is written to allternit_vault_credentials.encrypted_value. The credential list API never returns plaintext.

steps.title: Revocation without deletion
steps.note: Revocation sets revoked_at without deleting the row. This preserves an audit trail while preventing the credential from being used again.
